source_lines_after.4: title: "Periodic Fourier partial sums converge in the strict Lp range"
source_lines_after.60: [F4] For $g\in L^p(\mathbb T;\mathbb C)$ and $1\le p<\infty$ the Cesaro means satisfy $\sigma_Mg=g*F_M$, are trigonometric polynomials, and $\|\sigma_Mg-g\|_p\to0$; hence trigonometric polynomials are dense in $L^p(\mathbb T;\mathbb C)$. For a trigonometric polynomial $P$ one has $S_NP=P$ whenever $N\ge\deg P$. [[thm-fejer-convergence-in-lp]] [[def-cesaro-and-abel-means-of-a-fourier-series]]
